input.scope: 75 selected RGB-D captures from the 10 October live marker scan, exported from server without continuous camera pixels

measurement.method: Sequential isolated cold CUDA live replays of identical selected frames/settings, without archived pose seeds. Production server idle. Includes storage, preparation, tracking, fusion and scheduled preview; excludes imports, ZIP decoding, hashing and export.

depth_audit.method: All ordered accepted-view pairs, spread depth-grid samples and the existing scene_visibility empty-space audit.

validation.pre_existing_failure: RecoveryWorkflowTests.test_recovery_probes_wait_for_pending_check_even_without_adaptive_capture fails identically at the baseline commit. Client UI code is unchanged.

limitations: Single selected-frame recording; continuous client upload was incomplete during qualification.
11 captures remain rejected; one formerly accepted capture fails under the changed live trajectory.
Depth consistency and agreement with saved Finish poses are not ground-truth accuracy.
Legacy geometry paths can vary between CUDA replays; acceptance counts remained stable across the checked runs.
Markers must remain stationary and unique; unseen duplicates remain an identity risk.
Sparse/no-tag frames retain legacy tag/RGB/depth recovery checks; uninterrupted tracking is not promised.
